frozen_manifest_unit.title: Transient-state fluorescence observables and time semantics
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test a source declaration that keeps photon/FRET observables, FRET-derived distances, and ns-ms temporal semantics separated.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Can the Sanabria source record distinguish fluorescence observables, FRET-derived distances, and ns-ms dynamic descriptions?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Sanabria et al. (2020), Resolving dynamics and function of transient states in single enzyme molecules, Nature Communications 11:1231.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: T4 lysozyme, combined fluorescence/EPR/mutagenesis toolkit, and ns-ms state claims.

exact_pdf_locators.locator: PDF p. 2, Results, 'Detecting T4L's states by MFD'
exact_pdf_locators.scope: FRET efficiency, donor lifetime, fFCS, and time/ensemble semantics.

source_objects.native_observable: Single-molecule multiparameter fluorescence observables including FRET efficiency and donor-lifetime representations, with other methods in the hybrid toolkit.
source_objects.estimand: Transient conformational states, their exchange dynamics, and structural screening constraints in T4 lysozyme.
source_objects.statistical_unit: Single-molecule events and a network of labeled T4L variants in the reported study.
source_objects.spatial_support: Specified donor-acceptor positions and whole-protein hinge-bending context.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: The paper explicitly places its state and dynamic descriptions over ns-ms scales.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: FRET-derived distance sets are used to screen structures; they are not identical to the raw fluorescence measurements.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: The bounded record does not establish a universal mapping from FRET signal to every structural state.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract describes a hybrid fluorescence toolkit and 33 FRET-derived distance sets used to screen available T4L structures.
The Results passage describes FRET-efficiency and donor-lifetime representations, fFCS dynamics, and time-scale distinctions.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This source supplies a complex measurement-semantic challenge; no source-science conclusion is produced.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The source supports keeping raw fluorescence indicators, FRET-derived distances, and dynamic summaries distinct.
forbidden_generalizations: Treat a FRET-derived distance set as the raw photon measurement.
Infer a universal structural-state mapping from a single source record.
missing_information: All calibration and model-selection details are not extracted.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Separate raw observables, derived distances, and structural-screening use.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.
